description: Ley Federal de Protección de Datos Personales en Posesión de los Particulares (Mexico)
full_name: Ley Federal de Protección de Datos Personales en Posesión de los Particulares
regulator_full_name: Instituto Nacional de Transparencia, Acceso a la Información y Protección de Datos Personales

child.description: Parental or tutor consent required for persons under 18; consent must be express and documented

adult.description: Explicit consent from data owner (titular) required; must be free, specific, informed, and unambiguous

privacy_notice_description: A privacy notice (Aviso de Privacidad) is mandatory and must be provided to data subjects before or at the time of data collection

arco_rights.description: ARCO rights — Access, Rectification, Cancellation, and Opposition — are the core rights under Mexican data protection law

right_to_access.description: Data owner (titular) may request access to their personal data held by the responsible party (responsable)

right_to_rectification.description: Data owner may request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data

right_to_cancellation.description: Data owner may request deletion (cancellation) of personal data when it is no longer necessary or processing is unlawful

right_to_opposition.description: Data owner may oppose the processing of personal data for specific purposes

right_to_data_portability.description: Data owner may receive personal data in a structured, commonly used format (added via 2021 guidelines)

aviso_de_privacidad.description: Privacy Notice (Aviso de Privacidad) must be provided before or at time of data collection

data_processing_agreement.description: Data transfer or processing agreements required with all third-party processors (encargados)

privacy_impact_assessment.description: Privacy Impact Assessment recommended for processing of sensitive personal data

parental_consent.description: Parental or tutor consent mandatory for persons under 18

right_to_access.description: Must respond to ARCO rights requests within 20 business days (extendable by 20 more)

right_to_deletion.description: Must delete (cancel) personal data upon legitimate request

data_breach_notification.description: Must notify INAI within 72 hours of discovering a personal data security breach

sensitive_data_express_consent.description: Processing of sensitive personal data (health, biometric, racial origin, sexual orientation) requires express consent

cross_border_transfers.description: Cross-border data transfers require contractual clauses, binding corporate rules, or an international treaty; responsible party remains liable

location_data.description: Location data requires explicit consent and is subject to short retention requirements

automatic_decision_making.description: Automated decisions that significantly affect data subjects require human review

profiling.description: Profiling of children and for non-educational purposes prohibited

biometric_data.description: Biometric data is sensitive personal data requiring express consent

warnings: LPDC (LFPDPPP) applies to all private entities processing personal data of Mexican residents
A Privacy Notice (Aviso de Privacidad) must be delivered to data subjects before data collection
ARCO rights (Access, Rectification, Cancellation, Opposition) must be honored within 20 business days
Sensitive personal data (health, biometric, racial origin, sexual orientation) requires express consent
Parental or guardian consent required for persons under 18
Data breach must be reported to INAI within 72 hours of discovery
Cross-border transfers require contractual safeguards; responsible party remains liable for processors abroad
Fines can reach up to 320,000 days of minimum wage (approx. MXN $30M+) per violation
requirements: Prepare and deliver a Privacy Notice (Aviso de Privacidad) before collecting personal data
Obtain express parental consent before collecting data from persons under 18
Obtain express consent for all sensitive personal data (health, biometric, racial origin, sexual orientation)
Establish lawful basis for each processing activity
Have a data transfer agreement (contrato de transferencia) with all third-party processors
Implement a process to respond to ARCO rights requests within 20 business days
Maintain a data breach response plan with 72-hour INAI notification capability
Apply data minimisation and purpose limitation principles
Implement appropriate technical and organisational security measures
Designate a privacy contact or data protection officer for handling data subject requests
